property_summary: After a CashOut, the caller's balance in C never exceeds their balance before any deposits below MinDeposit were made—because the original C ignores sub-MinDeposit deposits, while the buggy mutant counts them, making balances higher—so a subsequent CashOut can succeed for more ether than the caller should logically possess in the original.
change_summary: Remove the check 'if(msg.value >= MinDeposit)' so Deposit always updates balances regardless of value sent.
